interpretation_limits: Static table combines active/passive movement and cites earlier literature, not a new normative population measurement.
Circular and prismatic grasp coupling tables are task-specific simplified model rules, not universal equalities.
Cyberglove reconstruction experiments are not this project's hand motion or human comfort validation.
Standard DH differs from BIO-06 modified DH and current BMC geometry frames; mapping still required.
